# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and generating PNG images of scheduled and emergency power outage charts in Ukraine.

The project fetches data from publicly available websites of power suppliers and stores it in JSON «as is» in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abridged):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored «as is», without structural normalization.

# Wuwatappo Native

Wuwatappo Native is the native Windows implementation of WuwaTappo 1.0.2, written in C# / .NET 8, WinForms, and WebView2. It connects to Kuro's official desktop pet service. This project is not an official Kuro project.

## Feature Summary

**Implemented features:**

- ✅ Supports all original online content and multiplayer
- ✅ Supports switching between the CN and International (Global) servers, with inheritance of official login
- ✅ Supports CN phone number + SMS verification code login (Kuro Pass)
- ✅ Supports customizing all skins (in others' rooms, only the skins you actually own are shown, but you can set any skin locally)
- ✅ Supports sending any emote (regardless of ownership or character restrictions; visible to others)
- ✅ Supports local fine-tuning of headpiece position
- ✅ Supports adding Key count (one click for +10000)
- ✅ Supports automatically claiming chests
- ✅ Supports auto emotes, auto tapping, and game mode rules
- ✅ Supports hotkeys
- ✅ Supports displaying the current keyboard/gamepad key bindings
- ✅ Rhythm game mode supports 4K / 5K / 6K, with key bindings saved separately for each mode; Space and punctuation keys such as ; ' , . / can be set
- ✅ Supports one-click inheritance of official login status
- ✅ Supports OBS green screen window capture for streamer mode
- ✅ Supports automatic avoidance of multiplayer characters, horizontal/vertical arrangement, and resetting sort order

**Detail optimizations:**

- Memory optimization: in the same scene (12 people on screen), the official version uses 650 MB of memory, while this version uses 80 MB
- Multiplayer saves each person's position: if someone disconnects or re-enters, or you restart the software, everyone stays in their original position
- Live capture optimization: uses an independent capturable window, supports custom window resolution, and avoids low image quality

Demo video: <https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1nRxk6dERS/>

# Vibe Logisim

**Build circuits, run simulations, and find problems together with AI.**

Vibe Logisim is a digital circuit workbench with AI collaboration. You can draw circuits yourself, or hand requirements and materials to the built-in AI, which can implement circuits, explain principles, troubleshoot errors, and refine the results with you.

Circuit editing, reading materials, AI conversation, and simulation all happen in the same window. Your work is saved in your own folder as `.circ` files that you can keep editing and running.

# Class of 2027 Job Information Board · Job Radar

This is a personal job information board for **2027 graduate job hunting**, not just a collection of scrapers. The goal is to consolidate opportunities scattered across official websites, Guopin (国聘), central and state-owned enterprise announcements, university career sites, Nowcoder (牛客), WeChat official accounts, and job-hunting groups into one workbench that can be filtered, reviewed, acted on, and pushed.

Current focus areas:

- Product, strategy product, AI product, data product
- Data analysis, business analysis, data science, data mining, machine learning/algorithms
- Roles closer to decision-making: business operations analysis, strategic analysis, industry research, digital transformation, management trainee/project management
- Non-internet opportunities to look at separately: central and state-owned enterprises, finance, FMCG/e-commerce, consulting, Hunan/Changsha, manufacturing digitalization

Version 1.0 is usable: `data/jobs.html` is the main workbench, `data/notify_preview.md` is the preview of new-listing notifications, and Nowcoder, WeChat official account, and job-group items go through a review queue and do not write directly into the main database.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies (Playwright is used for Nowcoder, Shixiseng (实习僧), and some university SPAs)
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 -m playwright install chromium

# Full sync: fetch all configured sources, write incrementally to data/
python3 -m job_radar.sync

# Export the single-page workbench: double-click data/jobs.html to open
python3 scripts/export_html.py

# After changing rules or profile, only rescore and re-export without re-fetching
python3 scripts/sync_plan.py rescore

# Recommended daily quick refreshes
python3 scripts/sync_plan.py core     # Guopin + central SOE announcements
python3 scripts/sync_plan.py role     # product/data/algorithm/decision core sources

# Generate the new-listing notification preview
python3 scripts/notify_preview.py

# Dry-run the push pipeline locally: does not actually send and does not write sent status
python3 scripts/send_notify.py --dry-run
```

The core code mainly uses the Python standard library; `requirements.txt` currently contains only Playwright. If Playwright is not installed, the corresponding sources will fail gracefully, while other sources can still sync.

## Project Structure

| Path | Meaning for humans | AI/maintenance entry point |
|---|---|---|
| `data/jobs.html` | Job board page | Final viewing entry point; data is embedded, double-click to open |
| `data/jobs.json` | Current job library | Auto-generated; avoid manual edits where possible |
| `data/jobs_archive.json` | Lightweight archive of taken-down/disappeared jobs | … |

Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-fish-memory.body:
# 🐋 Fish's Memory

**Gives sessions in DSH a long-term memory that fades over time, with every entry timestamped.**

The longer you chat, the more crowded the context gets. Compress it once and what came before fades.
This plugin keeps the memory for it: **what's worth recording gets recorded, things it recalls come back on their own, and unimportant things slowly fade.**

> The "fish" in the name comes from **DeepSeek's whale**. Whales are fish too.
> The other half is the "seven-second memory" meme: fish have poor memories, so someone has to remember for them.
> But it's not a hard drive. **It forgets, just like people do.**

---

## What it does

| | Description |
|---|---|
| **Fades over time** | Each memory has a "vividness" that decreases with age. The default half-life is 30 days. Nothing is deleted; it just becomes harder to recall |
| **Picks out what matters** | Not every sentence is saved. It judges which sentences are worth keeping on a per-turn basis, and there's a daily quota to keep the context from being stuffed |
| **Recall is based on evidence** | When you ask something, it searches by how distinctive the matched words are, then ranks results by vividness, importance, and emotion, injecting at most a few entries. Word segmentation uses a general Chinese word list, so "车" (car) won't match inside "车站" (station) |

# Akatosh

> In *The Elder Scrolls*, Akatosh is the first of the Nine Divines and the Dragon God of Time: the passage, beginning, and end of time all lie within his dominion;
> in the ending of *Oblivion*, his avatar descends upon the Imperial City and drives Mehrunes Dagon back into Oblivion. This project borrows this imagery: conversation history can be replayed, rewritten, and forked, like creating a little 'Dragon Break' between different timelines.

Akatosh is a local multi-user LLM agent centered on the concept of 'timelines.' It treats every conversation as history that can be replayed, edited, and forked. CoT, body text, tool calls, and context compression are all fully persisted. You can modify a node or fork a new branch from any message, letting different reasoning paths evolve in parallel. Web search, a Python sandbox, document reading, and image generation are integrated via function calling. All data is stored by default in local SQLite and an attachments directory, which suits long-term use where you control your own data, context, and costs.

Go backend + Vue 3 frontend. The frontend build artifacts are embedded into a single executable that listens only on `127.0.0.1:28888` locally, and data is stored in local SQLite.

- Conversation history on the left, conversation content on the right. In long sessions, **scroll up to load earlier messages page by page**; only the most recent few are fetched on the first screen
- **Web search (function calling)**: a per-session toggle. When enabled, the model can autonomously call `web_search` during generation to search the web (all tools share a circuit breaker of up to 8 rounds). The search process is visible in real time, and source links are saved with the message. The search backend is a self-hosted SearXNG, with zero API cost
- **Python code execution (function calling)**: when a sandbox backend is configured (`-pybox`), it is available globally. The model autonomously calls `run_python` to run code (calculation / data processing / verification). The code and output are saved with the message and can be expanded to view. # worm-vue3-print

An open-source monorepo (npm workspaces) combining a Vue 3 visual print template designer, a template expression engine, and an isomorphic rendering pipeline.

Design print templates visually by drag and drop, with data binding, expression evaluation, and pagination layout. All three endpoints share the same rendering and pagination algorithms (the logic has the same source; pixel-level consistency also requires the same fonts and the same Chromium engine).
Built with native Vue 3 and HTML/CSS/SVG controls, with no dependency on any UI component library, so it can be integrated into any Vue 3 project.

> ⚠️ **Experimental capability statement**: `packages/print-common` (`@worm-vue3-print/common`) and the example `demo-common/` are **experimental**. They are intended to provide the designer in a zero-framework runtime form (native custom elements) for **Vue 3 / Vue 2 / React / jQuery and other runtime frameworks** (including framework-free hosts). This package **has not yet completed stability testing**, but it has been published to npm under a formal version number (dist-tag `latest`, currently `1.4.3`; install directly with `npm i @worm-vue3-print/common`). The npm page keeps the experimental statement and includes Vue 3 / Vue 2 / React usage examples. It is not recommended for production. For Vue 3 projects, please use the mature `@worm-vue3-print/canvas`.
